Title: StrikeStub ClickFix RAT/stealer - domain
Description: Attacker domain that hosted the StrikeStub ClickFix loader served as Cloudflare.exe. Source: Akamai – Dissecting StrikeStub: ClickFix PowerShell Malware and Modular RAT https://www.akamai.com/blog/security-research/strikestub-clickfix-powershell-malware-modular-rat
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.

Title: StrikeStub ClickFix RAT/stealer - url
Description: URL of the StrikeStub loader that the ClickFix PowerShell command downloads to %TEMP%\svc.exe. Source: Akamai – Dissecting StrikeStub: ClickFix PowerShell Malware and Modular RAT https://www.akamai.com/blog/security-research/strikestub-clickfix-powershell-malware-modular-rat
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.

Title: StrikeStub ClickFix RAT/stealer - domain
Description: Compromised legitimate website that presented a fake 'Verify you are human' ClickFix prompt and copied the StrikeStub PowerShell command to the clipboard. Source: Akamai – Dissecting StrikeStub: ClickFix PowerShell Malware and Modular RAT https://www.akamai.com/blog/security-research/strikestub-clickfix-powershell-malware-modular-rat
RecommendedActions: Alert and investigate; do not block. This is a compromised legitimate site.
